text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOHOO! I like anything that's fun!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! It appears all of us
gathered here
today have an aptitude
for charming people!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Not sure if it has anything to do
with
attitude, but I'm always down to
have a good
time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Why stay quiet when we could get
the
crowd to make some noise?!
Festivals, opera,
sepak takraw—you
name it! I welcome all of the
above! ☆

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hah. While we're here, shall we form a
theater
trio? We can call our troupe the
"Black Gold
Opera O"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
BWAHAHA! Is it black or is it gold?
Opera O's
not even a color!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A theater group? That sounds fun! We
better
start practicing our singing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's try and sing in unison!
Ready? And—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... We are cacophonous! This, my
friends, is
art!
